notes: Train, validation, and test splits are source/composition-level, with 300 held-out test groups.
All dataset events used velocity token 3; velocity MAE 0.0 does not indicate learned velocity variation.
The annotation-aware timing MAE is higher than the recorded MIDI-only 4x768 result (0.066 seconds).
Metrics are symbolic prediction measurements and do not establish perceived musical quality.
Full training ran on CUDA; checkpoint files are intentionally excluded from this repository.
provenance: Sanitized from experiments/aam_annotated/reports/evaluation_report.json. No local machine paths or checkpoint file paths are included.
